changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionOwner') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner]( [FusionID] [int] NOT NULL, [ArtifactID] [int] NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionOwner] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [FusionID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Fusionowner_Asset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Fusionowner_Asset] FOREIGN KEY([AssetID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Fusionowner_Asset] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionOwner_Fusion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionOwner_Fusion] FOREIGN KEY([FusionID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Fusion] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionOwner_Fusion] END
